ALL THAT CERTAIN tract or parcel of land and premises lying, being and situate in the Borough of Haddonfield, County of Camden, and State of New Jersey being more particularly described as follows:

BEGINNING at a point in the Westerly line of Birchall Drive, distant 486.81 feet Northwardly from the Northerly end of the curve connecting the Westerly line of Birchall Drive with the Northerly line of King's Highway said connecting curve having a radius of 75 feet; thence

BEING part of Lot 6 on Plan of County Club Estates, made by Walter H. Macnamara, C.E., dated December 1956, revised January 4, 1957.

FOR INFORMATION ONLY: BEING known and designated as Block 91.11, Lot 32 on the Official Tax Map of the Borough of Haddonfield.

COMMONLY known as 32 Birchall Drive.
